Game situations that put a shooter under pressure

Source: R/pressure.R
pressure_situations.Rd

Following Zuccolotto et al. (2018), every field-goal attempt in a play-by-play is tagged with five situations that may make a shot harder, with their cut-offs:

Usage

pressure_situations(pbp, league = "NBA", orb_reset = 14)

Arguments

pbp

Play-by-play in the ggbasket layout (see pbp), all teams of each game.

league

League label for expected_fg().

orb_reset

Shot clock after an offensive rebound: 14 (NBA from 2018/19, FIBA from 2014) or 24 (NBA before 2018/19).

Value

The field-goal attempts as from as_ggbasket_shots(), plus shot_clock_left, score_margin, team_miss_rate and the five situation factors.

Details

  • shot_clock: seconds left on the shot clock, in four bands ("early" > 17, "early-middle" 10-17, "middle-end" 2-10, "time-end" <= 2). Play-by-play feeds have no shot clock, so it is estimated as 24 minus the seconds since the opponent's last action (shot, rebound, turnover), with a reset to orb_reset seconds after an offensive rebound.

  • period_end: the last 100 seconds of a period.

  • score_diff: shooting team's margin before the shot, in five bands.

  • team_misses: share of the team's field goals missed so far in the game, split at its 25th and 75th percentiles.

  • prev_miss: whether the shooter missed their previous shot in the game.
